name: Plague Caller
description: The dead listen to those who stopped listening to the living.
long_description: Some Scouts spend too long watching the hordes and start seeing patterns. Then rhythms. Then instructions. Plague Callers walk with the dead, curse with a graveside whisper, and raise walkers that follow them home. Every working costs a little more Humanity - and the deepest ones are simply not available to anyone still carrying much.
